component.name: OpenCraft
component.summary: Lightweight voxel sandbox game for desktop and mobile Linux

description.p: OpenCraft is a lightweight, deterministic voxel sandbox written in modern C++20. It features survival and creative modes, mining, crafting, farming, cinnabar automation, infinite multi-biome generation, dimensions, a dedicated server and multi-touch controls for mobile Linux devices.
First release candidate: world menu, HUD and inventory, real lighting, sound and creature rendering.
